description:
Share balances for an address, and what they are worth under each outcome.

Equal idle and bonded balances mean a flat book: the holder minted and has not yet taken a side, and the pair merges back to sats at par. The directional position is the DIFFERENCE between the two.

Read-only. Defaults to the unlocked wallet, which requires one; pass an address to read anyone without unlocking.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Stacks address to read. Defaults to the unlocked wallet.

name: atstake_position
